subject.title: Add config flag to always show provider in model picker (not only on name collisions)

question: Should provider visibility in model pickers be solved by a new opt-in config flag, by changing the default picker display policy, or by folding it into broader model-picker grouping/runtime-label work?
rationale: The source path is clear, but AGENTS policy treats new config/default/provider-routing presentation surfaces as compatibility-sensitive product decisions, and adjacent PRs are already changing related picker metadata.

options.title: Pick one default display policy
options.body: Make provider identity visible by default in the picker where it matters, keeping config surface unchanged unless users still need a preference after the policy change.

options.title: Add opt-in config flags
options.body: Implement the requested TUI and Control UI modelPicker.alwaysShowProvider settings with schema, help, docs, and tests for both fresh and existing configs.

options.title: Fold into runtime-label work
options.body: Defer this issue to the broader model-picker runtime/integration metadata design so provider, runtime, auth, and cost labels have one coherent presentation.

recommendation.title: Pick one default display policy
recommendation.body: Make provider identity visible by default in the picker where it matters, keeping config surface unchanged unless users still need a preference after the policy change.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is primarily about whether to add OpenClaw config/UI policy surface, and Vincent Koc appears in recent release/current-main ownership around the moved UI/config surfaces.
